properties.decision: Anthony, 2026-10-08, asked what happens to a requirement in the parent when it moves wholly to a part, chose "Reference replaces it" over "Keep it, marked moved". In the parent the requirement is dropped and marked moved_to_design / moved_to_node, and kept as history. The reference to its new home OBSOLETES it. The move needs the parent owner's approver and is refused while a capability in the parent still satisfies it.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-08 — a requirement moved to a part is replaced in the parent by the reference to its new home, and the move is refused while a capability in the parent still satisfies it
properties.rationale: One home per fact (the 2026-09-22 rule): the moved requirement lives only in the part. Keeping it marked moved would have needed a new status value and left two nodes for one requirement. A requirement the parent itself still realizes is not wholly the part's, so the refusal names the capabilities to re-home first.
